2017 HSC ANALYSIS - What to expect and common pitfalls
Surds and Rounding (2.3%) questions are commonly asked with surds having been
examined in a dedicated question in 7 of the last 10 years, but notably not 2016.
‘+ Rounding questions have required students to know "significant figures" (2011-14) and
“scientific notation” (2015) in recent papers. HSC Markers consistently comment that
students should write down answers to an adequate number of figures before rounding.
+ Absolute Value and Inequality (1.5%). Absolute value had a dedicated question in 2016
after a 3 year absence. Note that inequalities, within Topic 1, have not been examined since
‘+ Factorisation and Other Equations (2.8%) have seen a recent uptick in their contribution
